from: June book, night 9 (Saul Looks for Donkeys)
p1: Saul was a tall young man. One day his father’s donkeys were lost. Saul and a helper went to find them.
They walked through many lands, but found no donkeys! Saul said, “Let’s go home, or my father will worry.”
The helper said, “A man of Heavenly Father lives here. Let’s ask him the way.” It was Samuel.
p2: The day before, the Lord told Samuel, “Tomorrow I will send you a man.” When Samuel saw Saul, the Lord said, “This is the man!” The Lord had chosen Saul to lead His people. Samuel told Saul, “Your donkeys are found.”
Heavenly Father knew where Saul was going, and He knows where you are too. Tonight, thank Him. When you feel lost, you can ask for help.
old: There was a young man named Saul. He was tall and handsome. One day, his father’s donkeys ran away. Saul and his servant went to look for them everywhere.
After searching for days, they couldn’t find the donkeys. Saul said, “Let’s go home. My father will worry about us!” But his servant said, “There’s a prophet in this town. Maybe he can help us.”
They went to find the prophet Samuel. But Samuel already knew Saul was coming! Heavenly Father had told Samuel, “Tomorrow I’ll send you the man who will be Israel’s king.”
Saul was just looking for donkeys, but Heavenly Father had a much bigger plan! Sometimes when we’re doing simple things, God is preparing us for something great.
